text:
For Derek’s home recording studio, I recommend the Focusrite Scarlett Solo (3rd Gen) or the PreSonus AudioBox USB 96. Both are highly regarded for beginners due to their straightforward plug-and-play setup, durable build quality, and excellent software bundles that include user-friendly DAWs and instructional resources. They are compatible with most standard XLR microphones, which fits his current budget-friendly mic collection.

The amphibian that can change its color to blend with its environment is the chameleon.
